O1 requires open discovery before narrowing to frozen-plan defects. F/Q/C assert that sequence, but the admitted scientific captures do not independently establish the ordering. Excluded root histories, host/runtime files and earlier independent reviews were not inspected. Genuine public sources and problem-level framing were assessed; chronology remains unknown.

No score or component was run by this reviewer. Relevant pinned methods, issue/fix/release records and complete changed-file list were inspected. No exhaustive repository audit, new regression run, incidence estimate, cross-environment result or candidate tool trace is claimed. Expected future-validation and product-choice uncertainty is not counted as a defect merely because it is unresolved.

Yjs, Automerge, PDF.js and Verovio living pages are documentation-level discovery/preservation evidence only. MuPDF 1.27.2 and MEI 5.1 documents have identifiable snapshots; no code/integration guarantee for these alternatives was assessed or inserted into the candidate.
